capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Mercedes USA states a "122-kWh battery" for the 2027 EQS without saying usable or gross; electrive labels the sister 112 kWh pack "usable net", so 122 is read as usable on the same basis. This argument is weak (no page labels 122 usable or gross).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: electrive: anodes blend silicon oxide with graphite and cobalt content is reduced (NMC-type cathode); Mercedes calls it "optimized cell chemistry". Chemistry not named outright.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: The 2026 CLA release states navigation-triggered battery pre-heating before DC fast charging; no page was found for this car and Mercedes states no lineup-wide feature for this year, so this is a same-maker guess. Manual control unknown.

dc_max_kw.notes: mbusa data sheet: 350 kW at 800 V, 175 kW at 400 V. The mbusa 2027 EQS marketing page says up to 430 kW (430 kW is the EQS 580 motor output; Mercedes press and electrive say 350 kW).

ac_max_kw.notes: mbusa data sheet AC charging 9.6 kW.
